method: Directly inspected six local PNGs (one prior baseline and five after captures), read actual root browser receipt and saved DOM measurements, and derived comparisons from that saved JSON only. No live UI/server action, new app test, code/ref change or ledger edit performed.
sourceBindingLimit: Commit and bundle identifiers are taken from the root browser receipt. This reviewer did not independently inspect live runtime, source refs, deployment or network.

visualComparison.baseline: mobile-crowding-before10.png shows required/type badges and close/resize handles crowded around the four small fitted field rectangles.

after320.observed: Full outside field chooser wraps metadata across lines; two role buttons, a full Edit Field button and four separated directional controls remain inside320px. Four compact role markers are clearly separated and visible below the toolbar at the captured ordinary scroll position.
after320.fieldRectangles: No visible field-to-field overlap or page-edge clipping. The former overlapping badges/handles are absent from the mobile markers.
after320.verticalSpaceLimit: The320px toolbar is tall. This capture establishes visibility of all four tested markers below it at this scroll position, not that every PDF region is simultaneously unobstructed at every scroll offset.

after390Reopened.observed: Full selected-field metadata is readable outside the PDF, including text type, Tenant role, updated custom label, page1 and required state. Edit and four directional buttons fit one row. All four compact markers remain separated within the page.
after390Reopened.markerReadingLimit: In-page role captions remain short/truncated overview markers; complete editing information is supplied by the outside chooser and inspector.

desktop.observed: Desktop retains field badges/handles, two separated field columns and two rows. Full field chooser/Edit/directional controls are visible above the page; no field rectangle overlap or clipping is visible.

inspectors.observed: At390 and320, role selection, label input, required checkbox, explanatory copy, four resize actions, Delete Field, Close and the outside close icon are visible within the viewport. Resize actions are visually distinct and comfortably spaced.
inspectors.chronology: Inspector captures show the earlier label שם שוכר QA; the later reopened390 chooser shows the intentional saved suffix — נייד. This is consistent with receipt11 chronology.
inspectors.dialogOverflowLimit: The reported scrollWidth282/clientWidth270 is an incumbent outside close-icon extent. The320px PNG visibly keeps that icon and all inspected dialog content/buttons within the viewport; no dialog-content or page horizontal clipping is seen.
inspectors.targetSizeLimit: Exact44px movement targets and >=44px resize heights are root-recorded DOM observations in receipt11, not independently re-measured by this reviewer.

savedDomGeometryAnalysis.dataOrigin: MOBILE-GEOMETRY11.json; no fresh browser measurements by reviewer.
savedDomGeometryAnalysis.interpretation: The recorded matrix preserves the four field rectangles with small normalized pixel/canvas rounding variation (~0.001214), not zero cross-viewport drift. Nudge, resize and pointer reversals restore the initial derived canonical geometry, and reopened same-viewport geometry matches exactly.
savedDomGeometryAnalysis.visibilityLimit: Some recorded field rectangles are offscreen or beneath the sticky toolbar at the measurement instant. These measurements establish geometry, not hit-testing or unobstructed visibility. The separate320px after screenshot establishes all four markers visible after ordinary scrolling.
savedDomGeometryAnalysis.storageLimit: Canonical values here are derived from rendered DOM rectangles; this is not direct database-coordinate inspection.

rootBrowserReceiptOnly.limits: Actual mouse/keyboard events, draft save confirmation, library private-draft targeting and absence of republishing are recorded by the root browser run, not inferred solely from still images. Selected new label is independently visible in reopened390 PNG; all four required states/personal capacities are not independently visible together in those stills.

priorMobileFindingDisposition.basis: Dense field chrome has been removed from mobile PDF markers, while complete field information and larger actions are available outside the PDF. The prior overlay-crowding limitation is not carried forward as an unresolved blocker for this inspected chooser/inspector workflow.
priorMobileFindingDisposition.remainingBoundary: Small fitted PDF text/markers are overview representations; this approval does not claim physical-touch behavior or comfortable direct manipulation of every tiny marker.
